title: Moses — The Man Who Led God's People
memory_verse: "I will send you to Pharaoh." — Exodus 3:10
objective: Students will learn about Moses and how God used him to free His people.
content: When Moses was a baby, his mommy put him in a basket on the river to keep him safe. A princess found baby Moses and raised him in the palace!
When Moses grew up, God spoke to him from a burning bush! God told Moses to go to the king of Egypt and say, 'Let my people go!' Moses was scared, but God said, 'I will be with you.'
God helped Moses lead His people out of Egypt. God even parted the Red Sea so they could walk through on dry ground! God can do anything!
activity: Color a picture of baby Moses in the basket. Act out Moses parting the Red Sea with your arms.
discussion: What did God tell Moses from the burning bush?
How did God help the people cross the sea?
